resources.string: Recorder
Records what MyAnimeList answers to a signed-in user. It adds one title to your list, changes it and removes it again
The recorder works only on MyAnimeList. Choose MyAnimeList under Data source
Title id on MyAnimeList
The number in the title’s address. The title must not be on your list, must have finished airing and have\u00A03\u00A0episodes or more
Check title
Asking MyAnimeList about the title
Record on this title?
Kiroku will add this title to your list on MyAnimeList, change its status, watched episodes, score and dates, and remove it again. Nothing else on your list is changed

plurals.name: recorder_confirm_requests
plurals.item: It sends\u00A0%d\u00A0requests, two seconds apart, which takes about two minutes
